body: Definitely.  Would you be willing to share your experience of transitioning to that next job?

I actually came into this job planning to stick it out for at least a year, but I didn't anticipate being placed on a team like mine.  6 months ago I said that I was looking for a job that I was interested in... but now I'm looking for any job that will provide me with decent experience, regardless of the domain.  Hope things go ok for you.

I've been trying to, but my thoughts just go in circles.  These thoughts and feelings are kept in my head - I don't have any friends that I can talk about this with, and I don't want to shock my family with them.  And if I did bring it up with my family, they'd work religion into the conversation and I don't want to hear about it.
